# Parameters

<!-- Generated by `oxide-sim params doc`. Do not edit by hand: change the table in `crates/oxide-core/src/params.rs` and regenerate. -->

Every tunable value of the flight core is one of these 98 parameters (ADR-0004). Set one for a simulated flight with `--param NAME=VALUE` (repeatable), with `--params FILE.toml` (a `[params]` table of `NAME = value`), or in the `[params]` table of an airframe file or of a scenario file; they are applied in this order of increasing priority: airframe file, scenario file, `--params` file, then the flags. A value outside its range, of the wrong type, or that would break a rule between two parameters is refused and the run does not start. Units are the core's own: radians, metres, seconds, volts. "live" parameters take effect in flight; "disarmed" ones are accepted only while disarmed. A minimum of `> 0` means any value above zero; a maximum of `< 1` means any value below one.

## Rate loop

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RATE_ROLL_P` | Float | 28 | 0 | 200 | 1/s | live | Rate loop proportional gain on roll: angular acceleration demanded per rad/s of rate error. |
| `RATE_PITCH_P` | Float | 28 | 0 | 200 | 1/s | live | Rate loop proportional gain on pitch: angular acceleration demanded per rad/s of rate error. |
| `RATE_YAW_P` | Float | 12 | 0 | 100 | 1/s | live | Rate loop proportional gain on yaw: angular acceleration demanded per rad/s of rate error. |
| `RATE_ROLL_I` | Float | 40 | 0 | 300 | 1/s^2 | live | Rate loop integral gain on roll. |
| `RATE_PITCH_I` | Float | 40 | 0 | 300 | 1/s^2 | live | Rate loop integral gain on pitch. |
| `RATE_YAW_I` | Float | 10 | 0 | 100 | 1/s^2 | live | Rate loop integral gain on yaw. |
| `RATE_ROLL_D` | Float | 0.3 | 0 | 2 |  | live | Rate loop derivative gain on roll, applied to the measurement. |
| `RATE_PITCH_D` | Float | 0.3 | 0 | 2 |  | live | Rate loop derivative gain on pitch, applied to the measurement. |
| `RATE_YAW_D` | Float | 0 | 0 | 1 |  | live | Rate loop derivative gain on yaw, applied to the measurement. |
| `RATE_D_CUTOFF` | Float | 60 | 0 | 500 | Hz | live | Cut-off of the first-order low-pass on the rate loop derivative term. Zero turns it off. |
| `RATE_GYRO_CUTOFF` | Float | 80 | 0 | 500 | Hz | disarmed | Cut-off of the second-order Butterworth low-pass on the gyro for the rate loop. Zero turns it off. Must be below 0.45 times the rate-loop frequency of the profile (450 Hz at 1 kHz, 1800 Hz at 4 kHz); at or above that the filter used to be switched off silently, and now the value is refused. The filter is rebuilt when this changes. |

## Limits

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LIM_TILT` | Float | 0.61086524 | 0.01 | 1.39 | rad | live | Maximum tilt in the position and offboard modes. FS_LOC_TILT must be at least 0.175 rad above it. |
| `LIM_TILT_STAB` | Float | 0.7853982 | 0.01 | 1.39 | rad | live | Maximum tilt in the stabilized mode, at full stick. FS_LOC_TILT must be at least 0.175 rad above it. |
| `LIM_RATE_ROLL` | Float | 3.8 | 0.01 | 35 | rad/s | live | Maximum body rate, roll axis. |
| `LIM_RATE_PITCH` | Float | 3.8 | 0.01 | 35 | rad/s | live | Maximum body rate, pitch axis. |
| `LIM_RATE_YAW` | Float | 3.5 | 0.01 | 35 | rad/s | live | Maximum body rate, yaw axis. |
| `LIM_SPEED_XY` | Float | 5 | 0.01 | 30 | m/s | live | Maximum horizontal speed. |
| `LIM_SPEED_UP` | Float | 3 | 0.01 | 30 | m/s | live | Maximum climb speed. |
| `LIM_SPEED_DOWN` | Float | 1.5 | 0.01 | 30 | m/s | live | Maximum descent speed. It clamps the descent LAND_SPEED commands, so it must be at least twice LAND_TD_SPEED. |
| `LIM_YAW_RATE` | Float | 2 | 0.01 | 35 | rad/s | live | Yaw rate at full yaw stick. |
| `LIM_RATE_I` | Float | 30 | 0 | 1000 | rad/s^2 | live | Limit on the rate loop integral term. |
| `LIM_VEL_I` | Float | 3 | 0 | 30 | m/s^2 | live | Limit on the velocity loop integral term. |
| `LIM_MIN_THRUST` | Float | 0.1 | 0 | < 1 |  | live | Minimum collective thrust while flying, as a fraction of hover thrust. Must stay below LAND_TD_THRUST. |
| `LIM_IDLE` | Float | 0.05 | 0 | 0.5 |  | live | Lowest motor command on every motor at all times while armed, 0 to 0.5: a floor, not only a command for no demand. The thrust it gives (through the thrust curve) must be at most half of the hover thrust of a rotor, or the vehicle could not be held down or steered. |
| `LIM_STICK_DB` | Float | 0.05 | 0 | 0.5 |  | live | Stick deadband: a stick within this of centre reads as centred, and the rest of the travel is rescaled to the full range. |

## State estimator

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EKF_HORIZON` | Float | 0.2 | 0.000001 | 0.248 | s | disarmed | How far the filter runs behind real time. Must exceed the largest GPS latency, fit the profile's IMU buffer, and not exceed EKF_OUT_TAU. |
| `EKF_GYR_NOISE` | Float | 0.015 | > 0 | 1 | rad/s | disarmed | Gyro process noise (1 sigma), stated as PX4 EKF2 states it for a 10 ms prediction step; the filter applies the same noise per second at any filter rate: the variance added per second is the value squared times 0.01 s. |
| `EKF_ACC_NOISE` | Float | 0.35 | > 0 | 10 | m/s^2 | disarmed | Accelerometer process noise (1 sigma), stated as PX4 EKF2 states it for a 10 ms prediction step; the filter applies the same noise per second at any filter rate: the variance added per second is the value squared times 0.01 s. |
| `EKF_GYR_BNOISE` | Float | 0.001 | > 0 | 0.1 | rad/s^2 | disarmed | Gyro bias random walk, stated as PX4 EKF2 states it for a 10 ms prediction step; the filter applies the same noise per second at any filter rate: the variance added per second is the value squared times 0.01 s. |
| `EKF_ACC_BNOISE` | Float | 0.003 | > 0 | 1 | m/s^3 | disarmed | Accelerometer bias random walk, stated as PX4 EKF2 states it for a 10 ms prediction step; the filter applies the same noise per second at any filter rate: the variance added per second is the value squared times 0.01 s. |
| `EKF_GPS_POS_N` | Float | 0.5 | > 0 | 1000 | m | disarmed | Lower bound on the GPS horizontal position noise; the receiver's own accuracy is used when larger. |
| `EKF_GPS_VEL_N` | Float | 0.3 | > 0 | 100 | m/s | disarmed | Lower bound on the GPS velocity noise. |
| `EKF_BARO_NOISE` | Float | 0.5 | > 0 | 1000 | m | disarmed | Barometric height noise. |
| `EKF_YAW_NOISE` | Float | 0.15 | > 0 | 3.1415927 | rad | disarmed | Magnetic heading noise. |
| `EKF_GPS_GATE` | Float | 5 | > 0 | 100 | sigma | disarmed | GPS innovation gate, in standard deviations. |
| `EKF_BARO_GATE` | Float | 5 | > 0 | 100 | sigma | disarmed | Barometer innovation gate, in standard deviations. |
| `EKF_YAW_GATE` | Float | 3 | > 0 | 100 | sigma | disarmed | Heading innovation gate, in standard deviations. |
| `EKF_MAG_DECL` | Float | 0 | -3.1415927 | 3.1415927 | rad | disarmed | Magnetic declination at the site, east positive. |
| `EKF_INIT_TILT` | Float | 0.1 | > 0 | 3.1415927 | rad | disarmed | Initial tilt uncertainty after alignment (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_YAW` | Float | 0.3 | > 0 | 3.1415927 | rad | disarmed | Initial yaw uncertainty after alignment (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_VEL` | Float | 0.5 | > 0 | 100 | m/s | disarmed | Initial velocity uncertainty after alignment (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_POS` | Float | 1 | > 0 | 1000 | m | disarmed | Initial position uncertainty after alignment (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_GBIAS` | Float | 0.02 | > 0 | 1 | rad/s | disarmed | Initial gyro bias uncertainty (1 sigma). |
| `EKF_INIT_ABIAS` | Float | 0.1 | > 0 | 10 | m/s^2 | disarmed | Initial accelerometer bias uncertainty (1 sigma). Bounds how far the tilt estimate can wander in hover. |
| `EKF_ALIGN_TIME` | Float | 1 | 0.000001 | 60 | s | disarmed | The vehicle must sit still this long before the filter aligns. |
| `EKF_GPS_TMO` | Float | 5 | 0.000001 | 3600 | s | disarmed | GPS aiding stops after this long without an accepted fix; also how long horizontal velocity stays valid. |
| `EKF_POS_TMO` | Float | 1.5 | 0.000001 | 3600 | s | disarmed | Horizontal position stays valid this long after the last accepted GPS fix. |
| `EKF_BARO_TMO` | Float | 5 | 0.000001 | 3600 | s | disarmed | Height stays valid this long after the last accepted barometer reading. |
| `EKF_MAG_TMO` | Float | 30 | 0.000001 | 3600 | s | disarmed | Heading stays valid this long after the last accepted magnetometer reading. |
| `EKF_OUT_TAU` | Float | 0.25 | 0.15 | 10 | s | disarmed | Time constant with which the output predictor follows the filter. At least 0.15 s and at least EKF_HORIZON: flown on gust-hold, the estimate oscillates and the flight is lost below about 0.7 of the horizon (0.14 s at the default horizon). |
| `EKF_HDG_NMAX` | Int32 | 2 | 0 | 5 |  | disarmed | Heading corrections allowed per flight when the heading disagrees with the vehicle's own motion; the next disagreement lands the vehicle (heading invalid). 0 detects and contains only. Two: one correction for the fault, one for the residual or a second effect; a third means the error is not constant. In this version the check only watches and nothing acts on it. |
| `EKF_HDG_THR` | Float | 0.3 | 0.1 | 1 | rad | disarmed | Heading error worth acting on: about half the smallest error at which the position loop turns unstable (0.65 rad in Position mode), so what is left uncorrected keeps a factor of 2 of margin. PX4 uses 25 degrees (0.44 rad). |
| `EKF_HDG_K` | Float | 2 | 1 | 5 | sigma | disarmed | Confidence with which the heading error must exceed EKF_HDG_THR before the check says so: the lower bound at this many standard deviations (2 is 97.7 percent, one sided). 3 is the conservative choice. |
| `EKF_HDG_T` | Float | 1 | 0.4 | 5 | s | disarmed | How long the disagreement of the heading with the vehicle's own motion must hold before the check says so. PX4's yaw-estimator reset delay is 1 s. |
| `EKF_HDG_TAU` | Float | 3 | 1 | 10 | s | disarmed | Memory of the heading fit (a fading window): long enough to collect a few seconds of manoeuvre, short enough that a change of heading is seen within seconds. PX4's yaw estimator converges after about 3 s of acceleration. |
| `EKF_SOURCE` | Int32 | 0 | 0 | 1 |  | disarmed | Where the state estimate comes from: 0 external (simulator truth or motion capture), 1 the EKF. |

## Failsafe

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FS_RC_TIMEOUT` | Float | 0.5 | 0.05 | 3600 | s | live | RC counts as lost after this long without a valid frame. |
| `FS_RC_VALID` | Float | 1 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | RC must be valid this long without a gap before pilot input counts (arming, override). |
| `FS_RC_HOLD` | Float | 3 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | After RC loss in a pilot mode: hold this long, then return. |
| `FS_GCS_TIMEOUT` | Float | 3 | 0.05 | 3600 | s | live | The ground station counts as lost after this long without a heartbeat. Must be longer than the period at which the ground station sends it (the simulator's is 1 s), or a live link flaps between lost and found. |
| `FS_NOLINK_RTL` | Float | 60 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | Offboard with no human link: continue this long, then return. |
| `FS_BRAIN_TMO` | Float | 2 | 0.05 | 3600 | s | live | The brain counts as lost when its progress counter has not advanced for this long. Must be longer than the period at which the brain sends its heartbeat (the simulator's is 0.2 s), or a live brain counts as lost. |
| `FS_BRAIN_RTL` | Float | 10 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | After brain loss: hold this long, then return. |
| `FS_SETPT_TMO` | Float | 0.5 | 0.05 | 3600 | s | live | Tier-2 setpoints count as stale after this long. Must be longer than the period at which the brain sends setpoints (the simulator's is 0.02 s), or live setpoints count as stale. |
| `FS_GPS_LAND` | Float | 30 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | After losing position with nobody flying: hold this long, then land. |
| `FS_CLEAR_HYST` | Float | 1 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | A hold ends when its reasons have been clear this long. |
| `FS_FENCE_RAD` | Float | 0 | 0 | 1000000 | m | live | Geofence radius around home. Zero disables it. |
| `FS_FENCE_ALT` | Float | 0 | 0 | 1000000 | m | live | Geofence height above home. Zero disables it. |
| `FS_LOC_ERR` | Float | 0.7853982 | 0.35 | 3.1415927 | rad | live | Loss of control: tilt error above this for FS_LOC_ERR_T. The tilt error is the angle between the estimated and the commanded thrust axis; the heading is not counted. At least 0.35 rad (20 degrees): below it normal flight switches the motors off. |
| `FS_LOC_ERR_T` | Float | 0.5 | 0.1 | 3600 | s | live | Loss of control: how long the tilt error must stay above FS_LOC_ERR. At least 0.1 s. |
| `FS_LOC_TILT` | Float | 1.3089969 | 0.185 | 3.1415927 | rad | live | Loss of control: tilt above this for FS_LOC_TILT_T. Must be at least 0.175 rad (10 degrees) above both LIM_TILT and LIM_TILT_STAB, or the tilt the controller commands switches the motors off. |
| `FS_LOC_TILT_T` | Float | 0.25 | 0.05 | 3600 | s | live | Loss of control: how long the tilt must stay above FS_LOC_TILT. At least 0.05 s. |

## Battery

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BAT_LOW_V` | Float | 3.5 | 3 | 4 | V | live | Low battery threshold, volts per cell, on the filtered, load-compensated voltage. Must not be below BAT_CRIT_V. |
| `BAT_CRIT_V` | Float | 3.3 | 3 | 4 | V | live | Critical battery threshold, volts per cell. Must not be above BAT_LOW_V. |
| `BAT_DEBOUNCE` | Float | 2 | 0 | 3600 | s | live | The voltage must stay below a threshold this long to latch. |
| `BAT_FILT_TAU` | Float | 2 | > 0 | 3600 | s | live | Time constant of the battery voltage low-pass. |

## Return to launch

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RTL_ALT` | Float | 10 | 0 | 10000 | m | live | Return altitude above home. A change applies from the next return: one already under way keeps the height it started with. |
| `RTL_SPEED` | Float | 3 | 0.1 | 100 | m/s | live | Return ground speed. |

## Landing

| Name | Type | Default | Min | Max | Unit | Change | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LAND_SPEED` | Float | 0.7 | 0 | 10 | m/s | live | Landing descent rate. Must be at least twice LAND_TD_SPEED. |
| `LAND_BLIND_THR` | Float | 0.9 | 0 | 1 |  | live | Landing without a valid height: thrust as a fraction of hover thrust. Must be above LAND_TD_THRUST. |
| `LAND_TD_THRUST` | Float | 0.3 | > 0 | < 1 |  | live | Touchdown: thrust below this fraction of hover thrust. Must be above LIM_MIN_THRUST and below LAND_BLIND_THR. |
| `LAND_TD_SPEED` | Float | 0.25 | 0.1 | 5 | m/s | live | Touchdown: vertical speed below this. At least 0.1 m/s: the estimated vertical speed of a landed vehicle on realistic sensors reaches 0.09 m/s, and below its noise the touchdown is never detected. LAND_SPEED and LIM_SPEED_DOWN must each be at least twice this. |
| `LAND_TD_TIME` | Float | 1 | 0.1 | 10 | s | live | Touchdown: for this long, 0.1 to 10 s (a longer test is a vehicle that never disarms). |
